name: Tech Vaseegrah
author: techvaseegrah

sections.description:
Tech Vaseegrah helps WooCommerce stores collect WhatsApp restock requests and connect storefront automation features from one admin screen.

Features included:

  • WhatsApp restock form for out-of-stock simple and variable products
  • Secure proxy requests from WooCommerce to Tech Vaseegrah
  • Stock update sync when products return in stock
  • Scrolling marquee announcement bar with countdown token support
  • Responsive homepage hero carousel with desktop and mobile images
  • Customer video testimonials carousel
  • Progressive Web App support with manifest, installable icons, custom colors/text banner customization, and service worker registration
  • Amount-based WooCommerce shipping module with paid and free-shipping slabs
  • Checkout address auto-fill memory in the same browser
  • Floating WhatsApp and Instagram contact icons
  • Built-in image optimizer with scan, compress, restore, and upload optimization options
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP in WordPress from Plugins > Add Plugin > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open Tech Vaseegrah from the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Paste these restock values from Tech Vaseegrah into the plugin:
    • Subscribe URL
    • Status URL
    • Stock Update URL
    • Shared Secret
  5. Save settings.
sections.faq:
What shortcodes are available?

Use these shortcodes if your theme or Elementor template does not show the features automatically:

  • [tech_vaseegrah_restock_widget]
  • [tech_vaseegrah_hero_carousel]
  • [tech_vaseegrah_customer_video_testimonials]
  • [tech_vaseegrah_product_customizer]

What does the image optimizer do?

The image optimizer can:

  • scan uploaded JPEG, PNG, and WebP images
  • bulk compress large images in AJAX batches
  • support Lossless, Balanced, and Custom quality profiles
  • process original images only or all generated sizes
  • keep backups for restore
  • optionally auto-optimize new uploads
